transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, what brought me in is that people just keep saying I’m not listening. My supervisor at work or my wife, they'll be talking straight to me, and... a minute later I realize I only caught half of what they said. Then I'm stuck asking them to say it all over again. It's happening a lot, so I figured I needed to get it checked out.
Do you have any trouble hearing sounds, like needing people to repeat themselves because you can't hear them clearly?

No, my hearing is fine. I don't have any trouble actually hearing the sounds. It's not like things are muffled or quiet... I can hear the words perfectly clear. It's just that, well, my brain doesn't always register what they're saying. So it's definitely not my ears.
Were you having trouble paying attention like this as a child?

Yeah, I was definitely like this even as a kid. I mean, teachers were always moving my seat around because I just couldn't stay put. I was the kid who called out answers without raising my hand, and I got into a lot of trouble for butting into other kids' work. All of that was happening way before I even hit middle school.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things most days?

No, not really. I wouldn't say I'm a worrier. I mean, I get stressed sometimes if things get backed up at work or something, but I don't sit around worrying about different things every day. It's just not really something I deal with.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most days?
No, I haven't felt like that. I mean, I'm not depressed or down or anything. My mood is pretty normal, honestly. So, no, that really hasn't been an issue for me.
